1 — Home / My Gym Status
Capacity gauge, ฿349/mo membership, Smart Key QR

2 — Nearby Branches
Realistic map + branch list with capacity

3 — Community & Events
Stories, challenges, RUN / marathon / ice bath feed

5 — Reserve Gym flow (interactive: click through slot -> confirm -> success)
Opened from Home's "Reserve Gym" button — this canvas can't link artboards together, so try the flow directly on this artboard.

6 — Performance (wearable HUMF tech)
Replaces the Wallet tab — sleep/recovery/strain rings, health + stress monitors, today's activities.

7 — Unlock QR (interactive: click Done, then "Show QR again")
The same popup Home's "Unlock entrance" opens, shown here as its own standalone page — try the close/reopen.
